analyzers.name: apishape
analyzers.summary: Checks exported API parameter and receiver shape.

checks.summary: Reports unconstrained exported APIs with more than the configured maximum number of parameters.
Reports types that mix pointer and value receiver methods.
Reports long adjacent runs of parameters in unconstrained signatures that share one type.
Reports adjacent optional scalar parameters in unconstrained signatures that are easy to swap.

options.name: max-adjacent-same-type
options.usage: Maximum adjacent parameters of one type; 0 disables the check.

options.name: max-parameters
options.usage: Maximum exported function parameters; 0 disables the check.

analyzers.name: contextpolicy
analyzers.summary: Checks context placement, storage, and nil use.

checks.summary: Reports misplaced context.Context parameters while allowing additional contexts after a leading context and one context after a testing handle.
Reports context.Context values stored in structs.
Reports definitely nil context.Context arguments.

analyzers.name: closedomain
analyzers.summary: Finds builtin-string fields used as closed semantic domains.

checks.summary: Reports exported string fields used as small closed sets of values.

analyzers.name: wirepolicy
analyzers.summary: Checks serialized structs and their composite literals.

checks.summary: Reports positional composite literals for persisted or wire structs.
Reports exported wire fields without explicit JSON or TOML tags.

analyzers.name: borrowedstorage
analyzers.summary: Checks borrowed mutable storage transferred to a second owner.

checks.summary: Reports borrowed bytes.Buffer storage transferred to a second escaping owner without a copy.

analyzers.name: cancellationownership
analyzers.summary: Checks context and signal-derived cancellation functions proved lost on a normal return path.

checks.summary: Reports derived cancel functions proved lost on a feasible normal return path.

analyzers.name: channelcapacity
analyzers.summary: Checks that large channel buffers document their bound.

checks.summary: Reports large constant channel capacities in production files without a nearby bounded rationale.

options.name: max-unexplained-capacity
options.usage: Largest channel capacity allowed without a rationale; negative disables the check.

analyzers.name: channelownership
analyzers.summary: Audits callees that close channels exact callers continue to use.

checks.summary: Reports callees that close a channel an exact caller continues to use.

analyzers.name: channelsafety
analyzers.summary: Checks channel operations for reachable use after close.

checks.summary: Reports sends reachable after a channel has been closed.

analyzers.name: deferinloop
analyzers.summary: Checks cleanup defers whose lifetime extends across loop iterations.

checks.summary: Reports cleanup defers whose lifetime extends across loop iterations.

analyzers.name: exitpolicy
analyzers.summary: Checks process termination that bypasses registered defers.

checks.summary: Reports immediate process termination that bypasses an earlier defer.

analyzers.name: goroutineownership
analyzers.summary: Checks that explicit goroutines have a recognizable join handle or lifecycle owner.

checks.summary: Reports goroutines with a recognizable join or lifecycle mechanism that is not honored on every return path.
Reports goroutines without a recognizable join handle or lifecycle owner.

options.name: mode
options.usage: Ownership policy: context, lifecycle, or join.

analyzers.name: producerlifecycle
analyzers.summary: Checks that goroutine producers cannot outlive their receivers.

checks.summary: Reports producer goroutines that can block after their receiver stops waiting.

analyzers.name: processownership
analyzers.summary: Checks that started os/exec commands are waited on or transferred to a wait owner.

checks.summary: Reports successfully started commands that are neither waited on nor transferred.

analyzers.name: resourcelifetime
analyzers.summary: Checks owned files, SQL handles, HTTP responses, timers, and compressors are released on every path.

checks.summary: Reports owned resources that are not released on every return path.
Reports an invalidating operation on a resource that a direct release dominates.

options.name: require-reader-close
options.usage: Require gzip and zlib readers to be closed.

analyzers.name: concurrentcapture
analyzers.summary: Checks locals mutated by goroutines launched repeatedly.

checks.summary: Reports repeatedly launched goroutines that mutate the same captured local.

analyzers.name: determinism
analyzers.summary: Checks map iteration reaching ordered output without explicit sorting.

checks.summary: Reports map iteration that reaches ordered output without explicit sorting.

analyzers.name: errorownership
analyzers.summary: Checks that one function does not both log and return an error.

checks.summary: Reports functions that both log and return the same error.

analyzers.name: errorclassification
analyzers.summary: Checks that native Go errors are classified structurally.

checks.summary: Reports production code that classifies errors by matching their text.

analyzers.name: inlineerror
analyzers.summary: Checks inline error declarations for mismatched conditions.

checks.summary: Reports inline error declarations whose condition checks a different error.

analyzers.name: evalorder
analyzers.summary: Checks later operands that mutate values evaluated earlier.

checks.summary: Reports expressions whose later operand mutates a value read by an earlier operand.

analyzers.name: globalstate
analyzers.summary: Checks mutable package-level state.

checks.summary: Reports mutable package-level state without an explicit owner.

options.name: allow-names
options.usage: Comma-separated package variable names to allow.

options.name: allow-types
options.usage: Comma-separated fully-qualified named types to allow.

analyzers.name: lockorder
analyzers.summary: Checks contradictory mutex acquisition order and unreleased return paths.

checks.summary: Reports return paths that leave an owned lock held.
Reports attempts to acquire a lock that is already held.
Reports inconsistent acquisition order for the same pair of locks.

analyzers.name: oncepolicy
analyzers.summary: Checks sync.Once function wrappers that are immediately discarded.

checks.summary: Reports sync.Once function wrappers that are called and immediately discarded.

analyzers.name: syncmapatomicity
analyzers.summary: Checks non-atomic sync.Map load-and-delete claims.

checks.summary: Reports separate sync.Map Load and Delete operations used to claim one value.

analyzers.name: taintpolicy
analyzers.summary: Checks untrusted environment and argument data reaching sensitive sinks.

checks.summary: Reports untrusted input that reaches a configured sensitive sink without validation.

analyzers.name: testlifecycle
analyzers.summary: Checks that test-owned asynchronous work inherits the test lifecycle.

checks.summary: Reports detached test-owned goroutines rooted in a never-cancelled context.

analyzers.name: testpolicy
analyzers.summary: Checks lifecycle ownership in test helpers.

checks.summary: Reports test helpers that do not call Helper on every return path.
